entities.summary: Rory O'Hanlon was an Irish Fianna Fáil politician who served as Ceann Comhairle of Dáil Éireann from 2002 to 2007, Leas-Cheann Comhairle of Dáil Éireann from 1997 to 2002, Minister for the Environment from 1991 to 1992, Minister for Health from 1987 to 1991, and Minister of State for Social Welfare Claims in 1982. He served as a TD for Cavan–Monaghan from 1977 to 2011.
